title: Snow Dash Runner
description: Carve down crisp alpine slopes in a snappy side-scrolling ski runner—launch off ramps, pull clean mid-air flips, and stay ahead of the roaring snowball avalanche.
controls: Tap or press Space to jump over rocks and obstacles; hold in mid-air to perform speed-boosting backflips and land cleanly.

zh-CN.title: 横版雪地跑酷
zh-CN.description: 经典滑雪大冒险风横版雪地冲刺：踩跳台凌空后空翻加速、躲避巨石冰坡，在滚滚雪崩追上之前极限狂奔！
zh-CN.controls: 点击屏幕或按空格键跳跃躲避障碍，空中长按触发后空翻落地加速冲刺。
